entries.title: Proverbs 2:1
segments: My son, if you will receive My words and hide My commandments with you,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:2
segments: so that you attend to wisdom, you shall extend your heart to understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:3
segments: yea, if you cry after knowledge [and] lift up your voice for understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:4
segments: if you seek her as silver, and search [for] her as for hidden treasures,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:5
segments: then you shall understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:6
segments: For the LORD gives wisdom; out of His mouth [come] knowledge and understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:7
segments: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous; [He is] a shield to those who walk uprightly.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:8
segments: He keeps the paths of judgment, and guards the way of His saints.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:9
segments: Then you shall understand righteousness and judgment and honesty, every good path.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:10
segments: When wisdom enters into your heart, and knowledge is pleasing to your soul;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:11
segments: judgment shall keep you, understanding shall keep you,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:12
segments: to deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man who speaks wicked things;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:13
segments: those who leave the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:14
segments: who rejoice to do evil [and] delight in the perversities of the wicked;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:15
segments: whose ways [are] crooked, and [are] devious in their paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:16
segments: [They] will deliver you from the strange woman, the stranger [who] flatters [with] her words,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:17
segments: who forsakes the guide of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:18
segments: For her house bows down to death, and her paths to the dead.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:19
segments: All who go in to her do not return, nor do they take hold of the paths of life,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:20
segments: in order that you may walk in the way of good and keep the paths of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:21
segments: For the upright shall dwell [in] the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:22
segments: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
